verdicts.evidence: Ran the real runGates (fakeConfinement) + compareGates + gateTestCommand + applyGateEvidence from head on a temp repo with test/loopback.test.ts (binds 127.0.0.1:0, passes) and test/seatbelt.test.ts (test.skipIf(LIMITLESS_CONFINED==='1')). Gate: ok=true exit 0, coverage {passedFiles:['test/loopback.test.ts'], skippedFiles:['test/seatbelt.test.ts'], summary:{passed:1,failed:0}} -> criterion 'bun test test/loopback.test.ts' stays 'blocked': 'Factory gate substitution unavailable: candidate gate checks did not all pass cleanly without retries or skipped tests.' Control with the skipped file removed -> 'met'. Cause at head: passed() requires `!result.testCoverage?.skippedFiles.length && !incompleteTestOutput.test(result.output)` for every check before per-file coverage is considered. This repo's .limitless.toml test gate is `bun test` (full suite); runConfined sets LIMITLESS_CONFINED=1 (src/harness/sandbox.ts:226) and test/confinement.ts seatbeltSkip skips real-Seatbelt tests in gates.test.ts, scratch.test.ts, evals-implement-runner.test.ts (always on Linux).
verdicts.reason: The change chose fix option 2 (cite gate results), but in the very repository the issue was observed in, the normal confined full-suite gate always contains intentional skips, so substitution is always refused and the reported needs_human outcome persists; the reader profile was not changed either. The requested fix is not delivered in realistic use.

(stage 12); commands: bun test'. BunTestCoverage.observe (new src/gates/test-coverage.ts) is fed every stdout and stderr line in runOne (new in src/gates/run.ts) and treats any `<x>.test.ts:` line as a file header and any `(pass)` line as a passing row.
verdicts.reason: Output written by the change under test (untrusted per the project's trust rules) is promoted to authoritative factory evidence, letting a blocked criterion for a file that never ran be marked met; this path did not exist at base, where such a criterion stayed blocked.

Same reproduction: real `bun test` gate with passing test/loopback.test.ts and an unrelated LIMITLESS_CONFINED skip -> 'blocked' with 'candidate gate checks did not all pass cleanly without retries or skipped tests'; without the skipped file -> 'met'.
verdicts.reason: Duplicate of C4: an unrelated, intentional skip in the repo's normal confined full-suite gate disables substitution for the fully passing target, so the reported verification block remains.

verdicts.evidence: src/pipeline/context.ts stage(): inside stageContext.run, `this.state.completedChecks.values[name] = output.value; await this.save();` then after return `this.store.finishStage(stage.id, 'succeeded', ...)`. Engine (new) usableGates() requires `stage.status === 'succeeded'` for gateEvidence.stageId, and the cache path `return cache.values[name]` never re-creates the stage. save() without fault injection is synchronous (`this.store.setRunState(...)`), so between the two SQLite writes there are only microtask continuations, no I/O or macrotask; a graceful deploy restart (signal handler) cannot interleave there.
verdicts.reason: The inconsistency is real in principle and the dependency on stage status is new, but it needs a hard kill or crash in a microsecond window between two synchronous writes, and the consequence is the pre-change behaviour (needs_human), so it is below medium severity.
